slot_note: Batch 3 re-root of the anomaly-detection number: the indoor-air architecture's world is closed, so the draw moves to Criminology & Justice (the seed AD27's world, decision and quantity kept: how many offender groups sit behind a spring robbery rise and which ground each series team covers); the pitfall is re-found from the data, not the seed's resale chain.
niche: a municipal police service's crime analysis unit sizing its summer series-robbery teams from a spring rise in phone snatches at light-rail stations, where one crew rides the trains and strikes as the doors close at stations in several patrol districts, read against the transit system's own timetable
answer: four series teams: the Eastline group on patrol districts 4, 6, 7 and 9 (42 offences), the Hollin station group on district 5 (18), the Cobb Street station group on district 8 (16) and the district 6 street robbery group on district 6 (14)
answer_source: task204/generator/figures.json (n_teams, teams), recomputed by generator/verify.py from target/
analyst_test: With both occurrence logs deduplicated, every time put on Mountain time and the directive read correctly, the easy route links the spring phone offences the way crime linkage does by default, on method, suspect description, 1 km and 28 days, which puts a separate group at each of the four Eastline stations the travelling group works and files seven series teams, the wrong count with the wrong grounds; the golden is four.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the set of linked offence series behind the rise, which crime linkage analysis recovers from behavioural similarity and the distance and time between offences; here the distance that links a crew's offences is distance along the rail line in train time, read by placing each snatch on the trip leaving that station, and with another field's nouns there is no offender series, no modus operandi, no journey-to-crime path and no series team for the count to fund.

world.geography: Canada, Alberta (a fictional prairie city with a two-line light-rail system)
world.org_type: municipal police service (crime analysis unit) and the city's transit agency

driver: The units that decide the count are groups behind the events, and one group travels along a fixed network on a published schedule, so its events sit at the network's own departure times in sequence along the route; linkage by straight-line distance and elapsed time splits that group into one local cluster at each place it strikes and merges it with a local group that shares its manner, and only placing each event on the scheduled trip leaving its place recovers one group across several areas and separates it from the local one.
driver_concrete: Each evening snatch at an Eastline station is placed on the train trip whose departure from that station matches the 911 call, and the snatches that fall on one trip's successive departures are one crew's run, so the travelling crew is a single offender group across four patrol districts while the evening snatches at the one station it never works are a separate local group, which no grouping by station, district, method or description reproduces.
stump: A competent solver links the twelve weeks' phone offences the way crime linkage does by default, on method, suspect description, straight-line distance and elapsed time, and files seven series teams, one at each of the four Eastline platforms the travelling group works plus Cobb Street, Hollin and a district 6 street group; the step that lands them there is measuring the separation between the travelling group's snatches in metres and days instead of along the line, on the westbound train trip each snatch sits on, which joins four stations into one group across four districts and leaves Cobb Street, struck within three minutes of Union Yards on four evenings, a separate group.

lineage.niche: indoor air quality monitoring of a further-education estate's large teaching spaces against the outdoor-air requirement in the school building standard
lineage.driver: The deciding quantity is a transport rate recovered by solving a unit's own unsteady balance across the windows the organisation's own schedule files, because each unit's response time runs longer than those windows, so every reading of the same record that treats the measured level as settled overstates the rate by a factor set by the unit's volume per occupant, and no settled level anywhere in the record recovers it.
lineage.driver_concrete: The Tulrohan block's outdoor-air supply per occupant present is recovered by integrating each teaching space's carbon dioxide balance across the timetabled sessions, the stored term from each session's own first and last readings and the source term from the attendance register, because these spaces are large and sparsely occupied and their concentrations are still rising when a 55-minute session ends, so every steady-state read of the same record puts the block's supply above the standard.
lineage.stump: A competent solver applies the campus procedure note to the validated five-minute record, computes each session's steady-state outdoor air per person from the session's mean carbon dioxide excess and the attendance present, occupant-weights it across the term and files 11.0 litres per second per occupant present for the Tulrohan block, clearing the 8 litres per second per person standard so that the January allocation is spent on re-timetabling; the step that lands them there is reading a concentration that is still rising as though it had settled, in spaces whose response times run two to five times a session's length.

world.org_type: Education and Training Board further-education campus

differentiation.task272: task272 counts a period's output past a limit when a process drifts inside runs between resets and only sparse checks see it; nothing here drifts or is sampled, every offence is recorded, and the decided unit is the offender group, linked across places through the scheduled trip each offence sits on.
differentiation.task487: task487 prices events found at inspections, a share of them started by the inspection itself, from how often each kind is found against the inspection window; here no event is found late or started by an observer, and the timetable is not an observation window but the path that ties one group's offences together across districts.

notes: gate_g read against the vocab: the decisive step is the choice of the proximity that links offences into series (distance and time along the rail line on the trip each snatch sits on, against straight-line distance and elapsed time), pinned by the data's own structure; stump_strategy grain_or_unit: the decided unit is the offender group's series, built by linking occurrence rows through a network bridge (the timetable), never a key column.
